title: GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS
summary: General hose clamp and exhaust clamp positioning rules for the whole car, with dimensioned sketches: clamp spacing from the hose end on plain pipes, placing the clamp just past a sealing bead (never on top of it), shouldering hoses and clamps on short beaded or bead-less nipples, and centering exhaust pipe clamps on the end of the pipe slot. No specific parts.
notes: Plain pipe/tube/nipple with no bends: clamp at least .12 MIN from the hose end, and hose end at least .12 MIN beyond the clamp (as dimensioned).

Pipe, nipple, tee or connector with a bead: put the clamp directly beyond the bead (.03 MIN from bead, .12 MIN clamp dimension shown); push the hose on far enough for at least 1/8 hose protrusion beyond the clamp. CAUTION: clamp must not sit on top of the sealing bead radius.
Exhaust pipe clamps: locate clamp centerline at the end of the slot in the exhaust pipe (.25 dimension shown).
Short beaded hose nipples: HOSE SHOULDERED TO .03 MAX GAP; HOSE CLAMP SHOULDERED TO .06 MAX GAP; clamp .03 MIN from bead.
Short bead-less nipples up to and including 1/4 O.D. that are integral to a unit: HOSE SHOULDERED TO .03 MAX GAP; HOSE CLAMP SHOULDERED TO .06 MAX GAP.
